title: HOW TO IMPROVE YOUR PULL-UP
hook: HOW TO IMPROVE YOUR PULL-UP
caption:
HOW TO IMPROVE YOUR PULL-UP

1. Build your pulling strength
Prioritise exercises like lat pulldowns, rows, assisted pull-ups and straight-arm pulldowns.

2. Practise the movement
Don't just train pull-ups when you feel strong. Use assisted variations to accumulate quality reps.

3. Control the eccentric
Jump or step to the top position, then lower yourself slowly for 3–5 seconds.

4. Get stronger at the top
Add top-position holds and scapular pull-ups to improve control and strength through weak points.
